title: Fixed Dual Post and Open Ring Plunge Router
description: One newly authored complete static dual-post plunge-router appearance. A thick closed circular ground sole has a genuine central through opening. Two whole tall guide posts rise from finite foot sockets into separate fixed sleeves joined by two short bridges to one annular central carriage. A tall stepped motor body seats within that carriage and ends in a lower collet and one blunt fixed spindle above the open base centre. Opposite transverse handle stems carry two complete rounded dark grips. A top cap, blank front switch and short rear cable entry complete the exterior. Three opaque PBR roles; one prop and zero scenes. No old manual L-iron router plane, separate drill-press table or rear single column is imported. No cutting teeth, workpiece, powered routing, plunge travel, depth accuracy, insulation or engineering/safety claim; all whole geometry newly authored.
